page.layout: One page of continuous text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top left. No margin notes and no footnotes.

main_text.p: parárent: qui tamen nihil præclari fecerunt. Con-cilium Rhemis habuit, in quo manissima statuta pro monachis edidit, ut hæc sunt. Ne monachus lucri causa cœnobium exiret, ne puerum in baptismo testis leuaret, ne baptizaret, ne pœnitentias daret, ne ægrotos inuiferet, ne mortuorum funeribus adesset, & ne secularem Ecclesiam guberna-ret: cum ille ipse tamen monachus omnium Ecclesiarum monarchiam diabolorum sanctissimus usurparet. Sed ne scortarentur, aut pædicarent (quod sacrificulis ac monachis commune est) nullam tulit legem. Profanarum artium scholas erexit, porticum S. Mariæ ad præsepe extruxit, Gilbertinorum in Anglia sectam confirmauit, Norwegios per Hadrianum Anglum ad Papismum conuertit, & alia quædam prodigia fecit. Romam reuersus, anno Domini 1152. communi fato tum demum occubuit, in basilica Petri sepultus.
main_text.head: 109. ANASTASIVS quartus.
main_text.p: Anastasius quartus, patria Romanus, ex patre Benedicto quodam genitus, fuit primum abbas S. Ruffi in Veliterna diœcesi: postea sub Eugenio Romanæ synagogæ Cardinalis, & ex Cardinale Papa, uel ipsissimus Antichristus. Hic nihil fecit dignum, inquiunt Barnus & Funccius, quod ad posteros referatur, nisi quod calicem magni ponde-ris

page.notes: The first word of the page, "parárent", is a fragment continued from the previous page; the accent on the a is as printed. The hyphen in "Con-cilium" is uncertain (the line-end mark is faint) and is written as a printed hyphen. The large initial "A" of "Anastasius" is joined to the word. Long s has been written as a plain s throughout. The u/v and i/j changes are applied (e.g. "uel", "fato", "Papismum"). The final "ris" is a continuation of "ponderis" set at the right edge.
